ranked_axes.name: quantum_process_tomography
ranked_axes.description: qmirror.tomography.process(circuit, n_shots) reconstructs Choi-state rho via 4^n Pauli POVMs on Aer state-vector; verifies fidelity >= 0.99 vs analytic unitary on 4 standard circuits
ranked_axes.falsifier_statement: process tomography reconstructs analytic unitaries to fidelity >= 0.99 on all 4 test circuits at n_shots >= 4096
ranked_axes.rank_rationale: tied I*F=25 with cond.10; placed first on tie-break = closes 1.0 caveat #5 partial AND blocks 3 downstream conds (most forward-dependency value)

ranked_axes.name: ghz3_generation_mermin_witness
ranked_axes.description: qmirror.ghz.run(3, 1024) generates 3-qubit GHZ on Aer + measures Mermin-3 witness M = <XYY>+<YXY>+<YYX>-<XXX>; classical bound |M|<=2, quantum bound |M|<=4, GHZ analytic |M|=4
ranked_axes.falsifier_statement: qmirror.ghz.run(3, 1024) returns M in [3.7, 4.0] across 30 trials; min(M) >= 3.5
ranked_axes.rank_rationale: tied I*F=25; placed second on tie-break = self-contained (no downstream consumer in qmirror 2.0); but extends cond.5 Bell pair to 3-qubit max-entanglement honestly

ranked_axes.name: stabilizer_measurement_primitive
ranked_axes.description: qmirror.stabilizer.measure(state, stabilizers, ancilla_count) performs non-destructive Z-tensor-Z and X-tensor-X parity measurements via ancilla + CNOT gadgets; foundational for QEC
ranked_axes.substrate: Aer state-vector with mid-circuit measurement (4 qubits: 2 data + 2 ancilla) + ANU entropy
ranked_axes.falsifier_statement: Repeated Z-tensor-Z measurements on Bell |Phi+> return +1 with prob >= 0.99 across 1024 trials AND post-state remains |Phi+> at fidelity >= 0.99 (cross-checked via cond.9 tomography)
ranked_axes.rank_rationale: I*F=20; ranked 3 because foundational primitive but no downstream consumer except cond.12 (rank 4); enables full QEC stack in qmirror 3.0+

ranked_axes.name: surface_code_distance_3_toy
ranked_axes.description: Toy d=3 surface code: 9 data + 8 ancilla qubits in 3x3 lattice; weight-4 X- and Z-stabilizers on plaquettes; demonstrate logical |0_L> prep + 1 round of stabilizer measurement + logical Z_L destructive readout. NOT fault tolerance: no decoder, no error model, no logical Cliffords.
ranked_axes.falsifier_statement: logical |0_L> readout returns outcome 0 in >= 99% of 1024 noiseless shots AND all 8 stabilizers return eigenvalue +1 in >= 99% of trials
ranked_axes.rank_rationale: I*F=20; tied with cond.11 but ranked 4 = consumer of cond.11 primitive (build before use ordering); F=4 not 5 because of hard dep + 17-qubit ceiling proximity

ranked_axes.name: cscs_bell_chained_sequential_chsh
ranked_axes.description: Chained Sequential CHSH: 2 sequential Bell pairs measured on same backend with controlled time gap; verify each pair violates Bell (S>=2.7), pair-pair statistical independence (chi-sq p-value >= 0.05), aggregate witness W=(S1+S2)/2 >= 2.7 with std <= 0.10
ranked_axes.substrate: Aer state-vector (4 qubits) + ANU entropy; OPTIONAL $25 IBM Heron 2-pair anchor
ranked_axes.falsifier_statement: 30-trial outer repeat: min(S_per_pair) >= 2.7 across all trials AND mean(W) >= 2.7 AND mean(p_value) >= 0.05
ranked_axes.anchor_substrate: IBM Heron 2-pair sequential Bell N=1 burst
ranked_axes.rank_rationale: I*F=20; ranked 5 = extends Bell-class verification but does not unlock new module surface; closes partial 1.0 caveat (single-shot N=1 vendor drift not estimable); F=5 default $0 path; $25 optional anchor stays under $50 envelope

deferred_or_rejected_axes.name: magic_state_distillation
deferred_or_rejected_axes.rationale: Distillation protocols (15-to-1, Bravyi-Kitaev) require qubit counts >= 30 for non-trivial yield demonstration; saturates Aer SV ceiling and pushes to MPS where distillation entanglement structure does not compress; ~1 wall-week with significant tuning
deferred_or_rejected_axes.path_forward: revisit at qmirror 3.0 after cond.12 (surface-d3) lands; magic-state distillation rides naturally on surface-code logical qubits

deferred_or_rejected_axes.name: quantum_supremacy_random_circuit_sampling
deferred_or_rejected_axes.rationale: Sycamore-style 53-qubit XEB requires 144 PB SV RAM (hard fail F=1 at full scale); even at 15-qubit toy, the metric meaning ('classical can do this, quantum is faster') is INVERTED for qmirror (whose entire premise is classical simulation); cross-entropy benchmarking on classical simulation is degenerate (I=2 floor)
deferred_or_rejected_axes.path_forward: none in qmirror; belongs in separate nexus.qhardware module that consumes real-QPU output only

deferred_or_rejected_axes.name: variational_quantum_classifier_vqc
deferred_or_rejected_axes.rationale: Implementation feasible at $0 with Aer (~1 wall-week); but ML half (Adam, parameter-shift gradient) is mostly classical orchestration with trivial quantum kernel; no anima/nexus downstream consumer for VQC outputs identified; impact = 'we have a VQC demo' with no IIT/CHSH/anima_phi hook
deferred_or_rejected_axes.path_forward: revisit at qmirror 3.0 IFF a downstream module is identified that genuinely benefits from parameterized quantum kernel over classical kernel

falsifier_ledger.bound: Mermin M in [3.7, 4.0]; min >= 3.5 across 30 trials
min S_per_pair >= 2.7 AND W_mean >= 2.7 AND indep p_val >= 0.05
falsifier_ledger.substrate: Aer SV 4q (+ opt IBM Heron N=1 2-pair anchor)

five_honest_caveats: selection bias toward Aer-friendly conds: all 5 are $0 Aer-runnable; this is a deliberate post-1.0 retrenchment after cond.3/cond.7 hardware-burst band-revision pain; hardware-burst axes deferred to a separate qmirror 2.0-anchor cycle; means qmirror 2.0 by itself does NOT improve cond.7 cross-tech band-revision exposure from 1.0

all falsifiers are noiseless-Aer thresholds: 0.99 fidelity / 0.99 syndrome / 2.7 Bell bounds assume noiseless Aer; real-hardware execution would not clear without ZNE/DD/readout correction; if downstream re-runs on real QPU and FAILs, that is expected under the noiseless threshold and the spec must be amended (parallel to cond.3 0.40->0.55 revision) before interpreting as a 2.0 failure

cond.12 surface-d3 is a primitive demonstration NOT fault tolerance: no decoder, no logical error rate, no Pauli-frame tracking, no logical Cliffords; calling it 'surface-code on qmirror' without the 'toy' qualifier would mislead

optional $25 anchor in cond.13 is opt-in NOT load-bearing: default closure path is fully $0; if a sister credit cycle elects to land it, verdict.json should distinguish Aer-path PASS from hardware-anchor PASS; conflating would re-introduce cond.3-style band-revision selection-bias risk that 1.0 disclosed
